PC 2022 D-E1 card of [[Gambler's Luck]]: A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (5 March 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's. Source: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/79618fb53ef1e032f5503865e8edb70b8b58c7eb swccgpc/holotable commit 79618fb], 5 March 2022: card image gamblersluck.gif. Shown on [[Gambler's Luck (PC 2022 D-E1 card)]].
